_analysis_notes.backend_scope_note: The current backend is a FastAPI inference service for single resume-vs-job-description comparison. The required backend direction is recruiter-side batch CV screening against one job requirement with ranked results and summary statistics.
_analysis_notes.current_backend_note: Backend currently has working model loading, preprocessing, PDF extraction, single-file prediction, and raw-text prediction. Missing core recruiter workflow pieces include batch upload, multi-candidate ranking, DOCX extraction, structured screening summaries, and stronger file validation.
important_gaps: RESOLVED — Frontend now accepts PDF only; backend enforces PDF-only via app/file_utils.py.
RESOLVED — README and API aliases now aligned; api.py implements /predict_fit, /predict_job_fit, /predict, /job-fit.
RESOLVED — API responses are now typed via Pydantic schemas in app/schemas.py.

status_legend.done: Implemented in the backend and usable as-is
status_legend.partially done: Some backend implementation exists, but it is incomplete, misaligned with the required flow, or not robust enough
status_legend.not done: Required backend capability does not exist yet

_analysis_notes.execution_summary: All 6 recommended steps executed. New files: app/config.py, app/schemas.py, app/file_utils.py, app/screening_service.py. Modified: api/api.py, README.md, Front_end analyze.component.html.

features.name: Single CV screening endpoint
features.comment: POST /job-fit remains fully backward compatible. Now returns typed SingleFitResponse via Pydantic.

features.name: Raw text prediction endpoint
features.comment: POST /predict_json remains backward compatible. Uses typed PredictRequest and SingleFitResponse.

features.name: Recruiter batch screening endpoint
features.comment: POST /screen added in api/api.py. Accepts list[UploadFile] + job_description_text form field. Returns ScreeningResponse.

features.name: Consistent documented route aliases
features.comment: api.py now registers /predict_fit, /predict_job_fit, /predict as real FastAPI routes. README updated to match.

features.name: Typed response schemas for screening results
features.comment: app/schemas.py defines CandidateResult, FileError, ScreeningSummary, ScreeningResponse, SingleFitResponse, PredictRequest.

features.name: PDF resume text extraction
features.comment: PDF extraction via pdfplumber in app/pdf_utils.py, now wrapped by app/file_utils.py dispatcher.

features.name: DOCX resume text extraction
features.comment: Decision taken: PDF-only. app/file_utils.py and frontend accept attribute explicitly restrict to .pdf. DOCX is rejected with a clear error message.

features.name: Multiple CV file upload handling
features.comment: POST /screen accepts list[UploadFile] up to MAX_FILES=50. app/screening_service.py loops and isolates per-file failures.

features.name: File-type validation
features.comment: app/file_utils.py validates extension against SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS from app/config.py. Non-PDF raises ValueError caught per file.

features.name: Per-file error isolation in batch mode
features.comment: app/screening_service.py catches per-file exceptions and appends FileError objects without aborting the batch.

features.name: Job requirement text input
features.comment: Both /job-fit and /screen accept job_description_text as a required form field.

features.name: Resume-to-job scoring
features.comment: Cosine similarity scoring unchanged; now surfaced as score in SingleFitResponse and CandidateResult.

features.name: Candidate ranking by score
features.comment: app/screening_service.py sorts candidates by score descending and assigns rank (1-based integer).

features.name: Recruiter-oriented status mapping
features.comment: CandidateResult.status maps Good Fit→shortlisted, Potential Fit→review, No Fit→rejected.

features.name: Job requirement metadata support
features.comment: Still raw text only. Job title, department, location etc. not in scope for this execution phase. job_description_preview (first 120 chars) is returned for reference.

features.name: Per-request screening summary
features.comment: ScreeningSummary returns total_candidates, good_fit_count, potential_fit_count, no_fit_count, and percentage fields.

features.name: Accepted vs rejected counts and ratios
features.comment: good_fit_pct, potential_fit_pct, no_fit_pct all computed by app/screening_service._safe_pct().

features.name: Top candidates list
features.comment: ScreeningSummary.top_candidates returns filenames of the top 3 candidates by score.

features.name: Export-ready structured report payload
features.comment: ScreeningResponse is a flat, structured Pydantic model suitable for JSON consumption, CSV generation, or dashboard rendering.

features.name: Startup model loading
features.comment: Unchanged. Model loaded once at startup.

features.name: Separation of endpoint and business logic
features.comment: api.py delegates all batch logic to app/screening_service.py. Endpoints are thin.

features.name: Reusable batch screening service layer
features.comment: app/screening_service.py is stateless and reusable. screen_candidates() is the single entry point.

features.name: Configurable upload constraints
features.comment: app/config.py centralizes SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS, MAX_FILES, MIN_JOB_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH, MIN_RESUME_TEXT_LENGTH.

features.name: Model availability protection
features.comment: 503 guard now in _require_classifier() helper shared by all three prediction endpoints.

features.name: Graceful PDF parsing failure handling
features.comment: In single-file mode: 400 HTTPException. In batch mode: FileError per file, rest of batch continues.

features.name: Input quality validation for job requirement text
features.comment: _validate_job_description() strips and checks minimum length (MIN_JOB_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH=30). Returns 422 if too short.

features.name: Empty extracted resume detection
features.comment: app/file_utils.py checks len(text.strip()) < MIN_RESUME_TEXT_LENGTH and raises ValueError for near-empty extractions.

features.name: Batch-safe error reporting
features.comment: app/screening_service.py wraps each file in try/except and collects FileError objects. A single bad file never aborts the batch.

recommended_backend_execution_order: DONE — Add a recruiter-facing batch endpoint that accepts one job requirement and multiple CV files.
DONE — Introduce a shared screening service that extracts text, runs scoring, ranks candidates, and builds summary statistics.
DONE — Restrict uploads to PDF only and align frontend plus README with that decision.
DONE — Define Pydantic response models for candidate rows, summary statistics, and per-file errors.
DONE — Add validation for supported extensions, empty extracted text, and basic job requirement quality checks.
DONE — Align README and route aliases with the real API surface to remove contract drift.
